messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | mosse | initial moment / hour | மணி | hour | OK | | di (1st) | genitive “of” linking *prima* to *mosse* | *(none – expressed by the suffix ‑த்தின் in “நேரத்தின்”)* | of | UNNECESSARY | | prima | first / earliest | முதல் | first | OK | | quelle | demonstrative “those” | *(none – omitted in Tamil)* | those | UNNECESSARY | | cose | “things”, rendered as “season” | காலம் | season | OK | | belle | beautiful / sweet | இனிய | sweet | OK | | sì | resultative “so (that)” | அதனால் | so that | OK | | ch’a | conjunction “that” (introducing result) | *(none – result already expressed by “அதனால்”)* | that | UNNECESSARY | | bene | good | நல்ல | good | OK | | sperar | to hope (infinitive) | நம்பிக்கை | hope | OK | | m'era | “to me was” (experiencer) | எனக்கு | to me | OK | | cagione | occasion / cause | காரணமாக | as cause / occasion | OK | | di (2nd) | genitive “of” linking *quella* to *fiera* | *(none – expressed by the compound “காட்டுப் புலி”)* | of | UNNECESSARY | | quella | demonstrative “that” | அந்த | that | OK | | fiera | wild beast | காட்டுப் புலி | wild beast | OK | | a | preposition “with” (instrument) | *(none – incorporated in “தோலுடன்”)* | with | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article “the” | *(none – Tamil has no article)* | the | UNNECESSARY | | gaetta | dappled / speckled | புள்ளியுள்ள | dappled | OK | | pelle | skin | தோல் | skin | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY** (omitted because Tamil expresses the relation grammatically or does not use the element): - *di* (both occurrences) - *quelle* - *ch’a* - *a* - *la*
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected in the Tamil rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 40: - Original: **நேரத்தின் முதல் மணி, இனிய காலம்;** - Issue: Internal punctuation (comma) not allowed. - Corrected: **நேரத்தின் முதல் மணி இனிய காலம்;**
- Line 41: - Original: **அதனால் நல்ல நம்பிக்கை எனக்கு காரணமாக இருந்தது** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
- Line 42: - Original: **அந்த புள்ளியுள்ள தோலுடன் கூடிய காட்டுப் புலி குறித்து** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
``` நேரத்தின் முதல் மணி இனிய காலம்; அதனால் நல்ல நம்பிக்கை எனக்கு காரணமாக இருந்தது அந்த புள்ளியுள்ள தோலுடன் கூடிய காட்டுப் புலி குறித்து ```
